verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover all three rule types in the story. Natural-language guidance comes through path instructions and chat-taught learnings, AST rules through ast-grep instructions, and style-guide files (.cursorrules, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) are auto-detected and applied as review criteria, with org-wide central config and a request-changes workflow that can block PRs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that custom rules are reliably enforced in practice.

support.subject: As an engineering lead, I encode my team's own review guidelines — natural-language rules, AST patterns, or linked style guides — and the reviewer enforces them

citations.quote: Path instructions apply targeted guidance to specific paths, such as security checks for API controllers, coverage requirements for tests, or clarity rules for documentation.
CodeRabbit supports review instructions based on Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) patterns, powered by ast-grep
CodeRabbit automatically detects coding guideline files such as .cursorrules, CLAUDE.md, and AGENTS.md in your repository and applies them as review criteria
Review preferences CodeRabbit learns from your chat conversations and applies automatically to future reviews.
Maintain CodeRabbit configuration for your entire organization in one dedicated repository.
